rules.statement: A sale of immovable property over Rs. 1,000 must be advertised in the Government Gazette at least twenty days prior to the sale.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appears to me that the provisions as to publication in the Government Gazette are imperative, and are not to be exercised at the caprice of the execution-creditor"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 256 of the Civil Procedure Code
